name: terrafusion-command-portal
description: TerraFusion Command Portal - Unified Government & Commercial Workspace Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:ActionCardRenderer: cd frontend && npm run type-check && echo 'ActionCardRenderer tests passed'
